# MWI Ultimate Enhancement Tracker

The enhancement tracker in `src/features/enhancement/` (`enhancement-ui.js`,
`enhancement-handlers.js`, `enhancement-xp.js`) is based on
[MWI Ultimate Enhancement Tracker v3.7.9](https://greasyfork.org/en/scripts/531872)
by TheNeroNex (MIT) — its material-cost tracking, XP formulas and panel
styling. The license text below is the MIT license the listing declares; the
listing states no year.
